name: The Butts and the Briar
description: You have come to Fernhold, the foresters' lodge on the High Wold, to learn the bow from Rosen Wyke; the lodge eats because she shoots. Thornhounds are drinking at Wold Force, south of the lodge, and killing the lodge's deer. This evening she means to clear them, with you.
notes: The ranger's tutorial (docs/FIGHTING_STYLE_STARTS.md 3.2, 3.2a), begun by core:opening/ranger, made plainer for triage 51-52: one goal (clear the thornhounds from Wold Force this evening), told by Rosen at once; four stages (the butts, the Briar, the Force, the report and the hart), the weaver in Fern Gully cut; every change of stage said out loud as it happens, each journal entry opening on why. Nettle is handed over after the first lesson (the_butts' on_complete, tethered behind the line: `nettle_tether`) and ridden out to the Briar (`mount`, Rider). The butts are Pell bodies of kind butt (QuestSpots `props`, `prop:butt`), 20, 35 and 50 m down the range from the shooting line; the thornhounds are Wold Force's own three, and Rosen shoots only if you are hurt (`overwatch`, Sparring's sibling in Overwatch). The report shows the grey hart (`saw_the_grey_hart`, which stands its lead at the clearing's edge); Alder asks you to follow it, and The Grey Hart begins with the ride. Rosen's and Alder's lines are in their dialogues and hold them at the butts, the Briar and the lip (their npc defs' holds).

spots.name: nettle_tether
spots.notes: behind the shooting line, off the range, where Rosen has Nettle tied when you walk back from the Force

stages.journal:
This evening Rosen clears the thornhounds from Wold Force, where they have been killing the lodge's deer, and you are to shoot them from the high ground before they find you. First she wants to see you hit what you aim at.

Go to the shooting line across Fernhold's common and hit the three straw butts down the range: the near one twice, then the middle one, then the far one.

How: draw and hold, and let go on the out-breath. Holding the draw costs stamina for as long as you hold it. The further the butt, the more the arrow falls on the way, so aim over the far one.

objectives.text: Hit the near butt twice: draw with {key:attack_light}, hold, let go

say: Breathe out. Loose on the empty. The arrow doesn't care how brave you are.

objectives.text: Hit the middle butt, at thirty-five paces

say: It dropped. They all drop. Aim where it's going to be, not where it is.

objectives.text: Hit the far butt, at fifty paces: aim over it

say: Good. Pull them out of the straw; arrows are a thing that runs out. — Take Nettle, my old pony; she's tied behind the line. The Force is a long walk and you'll want legs under you after. Now come and see where the hounds are coming from. My father's on the Briar.

stages.journal:
You can hit what you aim at. Before the Force, Rosen wants you to see where the thornhounds are coming from: the Briar, the wall of thorn the Oroth grew to keep the Hush in the south. Her father Alder walks it every morning.

Get up on Nettle, the pony Rosen has given you, and ride out north-west of the lodge to the edge of the Briar. Go the last of it crouched, and find Rosen and Alder there.

How: crouched, you are harder to see and hear. You will need it at the Force.

objectives.text: Get up on Nettle {key:interact}, behind the shooting line
Find Alder Wyke on the Briar, north-west of the lodge, and watch him count

say: That's why they're out. The wall's going grey and what lived in it is leaving. Now the Force: they come down to drink at evening. I'll be on the high ground.

stages.journal:
You have seen the grey in the Briar, and why the hounds are out. It is evening, and they come down to drink.

Go to Wold Force, the waterfall a long bowshot south of the lodge. Rosen waits on the high ground over the pool, on its east side. Put down the three thornhounds when they come down to drink.

How: shoot from up there before they find you. If one closes, take the knife into your hand and roll back until the bow is some use again. Rosen will not shoot unless you are hurt.

objectives.text: Put down the three thornhounds at Wold Force
Hit them from the high ground, before they find you
When one closes, take the knife into your hand {key:quick_4}

say: That's all three. Walk back with me. Tell me at the lodge.

stages.journal:
The pool is quiet. Rosen wants it told at the lodge.

Ride back to Fernhold and tell Rosen the thornhounds are down.

objectives.text: Tell Rosen at the lodge the pool is quiet

name: The Grey Hart
description: The hart whose slots you saw on the Briar has gone grey, and it is walking south out of the wood. It does not run from you. Rosen and her father want to know where it goes.
notes: The ranger's tie-in (docs/FIGHTING_STYLE_STARTS.md 3.2, 3.2a): the hart is a lead (Leads) that keeps ahead of the player by road, the recommended ride that does not touch the Standing Moot, by Grandfather Hollow and Tamwick; a thornhound pack at Tamwick, come south after the hart (QuestFoes); a Hearthstone halfway at Ansel's Hedge Shrine; and the Stair Head, where the hart walks past the Warden's fire and down the stair, and the Naming begins at down_the_stair. Nettle was given in the tutorial's first stage and the hart shown on Rosen's report (triage 52), so the first objective is the ride; Alder's ask is his dialogue while you follow.

stages.journal:
The hart whose slots you saw on the Briar is standing at the edge of the clearing, grey, and walking south out of the wood. Rosen and Alder want to know where it goes.

Ride Nettle after it, south by the road to Grandfather Hollow. Do not shoot it. It keeps a field ahead of you however you come on, and waits if you fall back.

Alder, at the lodge, will tell you what he thinks it is, if you ask. Whistle for Nettle if you leave her behind.

objectives.text: Ride after the grey hart south to Grandfather Hollow

stages.journal:
Past Grandfather Hollow, three thornhounds came out of the Briar onto the road behind the hart. They are not after it; they are going the same way, and you are in it.

Put down the three thornhounds on the road north-east of Tamwick.

The hart went round the Standing Moot, where the Hart of Thorns stands in the stones, and did not look at it.

objectives.text: Put down the thornhounds on the Tamwick road

on_enter.notify: Thornhounds on the road behind the hart, come out of the Briar.

on_complete.notify: The hart has stopped on the road, and waits. A Hearthstone stands at Ansel's Hedge Shrine, just off it.

stages.journal:
The hart has stopped on the road past Tamwick and is waiting, which a hart does not do. Alder said to touch the Hearthstone at Ansel's Hedge Shrine on the way: if the road kills you, you wake at the last stone you touched.

Turn off the road west of Tamwick to Ansel's Hedge Shrine and put your hand on the Hearthstone in its lee.

objectives.text: Turn off to Ansel's Hedge Shrine
Put your hand on the shrine's Hearthstone

on_complete.notify: The hart walks on south, into the Vale.

stages.journal:
The hart walks on south through the Vale, by Merrowby, Wynstead and Ashwell to Pilgrim's Ash, and past the Sunken Choir to where the road ends: a Wardens' camp on a cliff's edge, at the top of a stair going down into grey mist.

Follow it there, and speak to the Warden at her fire.

objectives.text: Speak to the Warden at the Stair Head

say: Don't. It's not yours to stop. — It's going down. It's going down! Nobody comes back up!
